description: This file contains functions related to behavioral analysis in the BORIS software, including statistical measures such as Cohen's Kappa and Needleman-Wunsch similarity for observations, accessing and manipulating behavioral event data stored in a SQLite database, and involving user interactions for analysis parameters.

methods.name: list subj_behav_modif(cursor, obsid: str, subject: str, time: dec, interval, include_modifiers: bool)
methods.description: Retrieves behaviors and modifiers for a specific subject at a given time within an observation, considering interval and whether to include modifiers.

methods.name: cohen_kappa(cursor, obsid1: str, obsid2: str, interval: dec, selected_subjects: list, include_modifiers: bool)
methods.description: Computes Cohen's Kappa coefficient (time-unit) between two observations based on behavioral event data.

methods.name: irr_cohen_kappa(self)
methods.description: Integrates user interaction, data validation, and calls cohen_kappa for multiple observations to analyze inter-rater reliability.

methods.name: needleman_wunsch_identity(cursor, obsid1: str, obsid2: str, interval, selected_subjects: list, include_modifiers: bool)
methods.description: Performs sequence alignment (Needleman-Wunsch algorithm) between two observations' behavior sequences, returning identity score and alignment details.

methods.name: needleman_wunch(self)
methods.description: Calculates similarities between two or more observations using Needleman-Wunsch, managing user prompts, data retrieval, and displaying results.
